title: Pineapple From Jungle Leaves
description: Adds a pineapple drop from jungle leaves
body:
## 🌿🍍 Pineapple From Jungles Leaves

This lightweight and fun datapack/texturepack allows you to obtain **pineapples straight from jungle leaves!**  
It adds a tropical twist to exploring jungle biomes and makes harvesting leaves much more rewarding.

### ✨ Features:
- Chance for a *pineapple* to drop from jungle tree leaves  
- Perfect for survival and skyblock gameplay  
- Fully compatible with other datapacks  
- Zero lag, clean and simple mechanics

Break leaves → get pineapples → enjoy the tropical adventure! 🌴🍍

REMEMBER YOU ALSO NEED DOWNLOAD TEXTUREPACK!
